import { redact } from './relay-redact'
import { isSmallTalk, unlink } from './relay-text'

export const RELAY_FILE = 'relais.md'
export const RESUME_MARK = 'You are continuing a previous session'

// Encoded characters the prompt may take inside the claude:// deep link.
const LINK_BUDGET = 7000
const TAIL_MESSAGES = 2
const TAIL_SIZES = [700, 300, 0]
const SUMMARY_FLOOR = 1500

// Shipped comes last on purpose: when the prompt must be cut, the cut falls on the least useful part.
export const RELAY_PROMPT = `Summarize this conversation so a fresh session can pick it up without losing anything.
Answer ONLY in English markdown, with exactly these five sections, in this order:

# Handoff

## Goal
(what this conversation is for, in 1 to 3 sentences)

## Up next
(bullet list, in order, the next action first)

## Locked in
(bullet list of decisions made and why, not to be reopened)

## Suggested skills
(skills the next session should invoke, one per line with a few words on why; write "none" if no skill applies)

## Shipped
(bullet list of what is finished, with file paths when useful)

Rules:
- Keep the whole answer under 2500 characters.
- Do not copy what already lives in a spec, plan, issue, commit or diff: point to it by path or URL instead.
- Never include secrets or personal data (passwords, tokens, API keys, emails, phone numbers, addresses). Write "[redacted]" if one is needed to make sense.
- Describe the current state, not the conversation: never write "the user said" or "the assistant did".
- In Locked in, keep only decisions specific to this task; leave general repo conventions (commit style, push rules) to the project CLAUDE.md.
- Use plain paths and commit hashes, no markdown links.
- Be concise and factual. Invent nothing.`

const flat = (t: string) => t.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
const head = (t: string, n: number) => (t.length > n ? `${t.slice(0, n)}…` : t)
const tailOf = (t: string, n: number) => (t.length > n ? `…${t.slice(-n)}` : t)
const cost = (t: string) => encodeURIComponent(t).length

/**
 * The prompt that opens the new session: handoff, end of the old chat, then the ask.
 * Sized by its encoded length, since spaces, newlines and accents all swell in a URL. The end of
 * each message is kept (that is where the open question is) and the summary is cut from the back.
 */
export const buildResume = (
  handoff: string,
  history: { role: string; text: string }[],
  cwd: string,
  file: string,
): string => {
  const messages = history.filter(m => m.text && m.text.trim() !== '' && !isSmallTalk(m.text)).slice(-TAIL_MESSAGES)
  const compose = (summaryMax: number, tailMax: number): string =>
    [
      `${RESUME_MARK}. Previous working folder: ${cwd}. The full handoff is also saved at ${file}.`,
      head(unlink(redact(handoff)), summaryMax),
      tailMax > 0 && messages.length > 0
        ? `End of the previous conversation:\n\n${messages.map(m => `[${m.role}] ${tailOf(flat(redact(m.text)), tailMax)}`).join('\n\n')}`
        : '',
      'Summarize Goal and Up next in two lines, then continue from Up next.',
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join('\n\n')

  // Cut the summary first (down to a floor), then the messages, so the open question is the last thing to go.
  let text = ''
  for (const tailMax of TAIL_SIZES) {
    let summaryMax = handoff.length
    text = compose(summaryMax, tailMax)
    while (summaryMax > SUMMARY_FLOOR && cost(text) > LINK_BUDGET) {
      summaryMax = Math.max(SUMMARY_FLOOR, Math.floor(summaryMax * 0.85))
      text = compose(summaryMax, tailMax)
    }
    if (cost(text) <= LINK_BUDGET) return text
  }

  return text
}

const MASK = '[redacted]'

// Each pattern matches one family of secret or personal data. Order matters: the long blocks go first.
const PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  /-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----/g,
  /\b[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/[^\s:@/]+:[^\s@/]+@/gi,
  /\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}/g,
  /\b(?:ghp|gho|ghu|ghs|ghr)_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}/g,
  /\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}/g,
  /\bxox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}/g,
  /\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b/g,
  /\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}/g,
  /\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}/g,
  /\bBearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{16,}/gi,
  // A password or secret is masked from 4 characters; a token or key from 8, never a call like getToken().
  /\b(?:password|passwd|pwd|secret)\b["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?[^\s"',;]{4,}["']?/gi,
  /\b(?:token|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?key)\b["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?[^\s"',;()]{8,}(?!\()["']?/gi,
  /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)*\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g,
]

/** Replaces secrets and personal data (keys, tokens, passwords, credentials in URLs, e-mails) with a mask. */
export const redact = (text: string): string => PATTERNS.reduce((out, pattern) => out.replace(pattern, MASK), text)

import type { RelayStep } from '../types'

export const STEPS: RelayStep[] = [
  { id: 'read', label: 'Read this session', status: 'wait' },
  { id: 'sum', label: 'Summarize the conversation', status: 'wait' },
  { id: 'file', label: 'Save the handoff', status: 'wait' },
  { id: 'launch', label: 'Open a new session', status: 'wait' },
  { id: 'send', label: 'Send the first message', status: 'wait' },
]

export const secs = (ms: number) => `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`

/** The project folder's name made safe for a file name (and a PowerShell string). */
export const safeName = (cwd: string) => (cwd.split(/[\\/]/).filter(Boolean).pop() ?? 'session').replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, '_')

import { RESUME_MARK } from './relay-prompt'

const A = 'System.Windows.Automation'
// Inside a single-quoted PowerShell string, a quote is written twice.
const quoted = (s: string) => s.replace(/'/g, "''")

/**
 * PowerShell that focuses Claude, accepts the workspace-trust dialog if shown, finds the
 * prompt box through UI Automation, waits for the prefilled handoff, then presses Enter.
 * Each step is logged to `log` so a silent failure can be read afterwards.
 */
export const sendScript = (log: string): string =>
  [
    `$log = '${quoted(log)}'; function L($m) { Add-Content $log ((Get-Date -Format o) + ' ' + $m) }`,
    "L 'spawn'; Add-Type -AssemblyName UIAutomationClient,UIAutomationTypes",
    "L 'start'; $s = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $done = $false",
    `$btn = [${A}.ControlType]::Button; $edit = [${A}.ControlType]::Edit`,
    `$pid2 = [${A}.AutomationElement]::ProcessIdProperty; $typ = [${A}.AutomationElement]::ControlTypeProperty`,
    "$id = (Get-Process claude | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -ne '' } | Select-Object -First 1).Id",
    'foreach ($i in 1..40) {',
    "[void]$s.AppActivate('Claude')",
    `$w = [${A}.AutomationElement]::RootElement.FindFirst('Children', (New-Object ${A}.PropertyCondition($pid2, $id)))`,
    `if ($w) { foreach ($b in $w.FindAll('Descendants', (New-Object ${A}.PropertyCondition($typ, $btn)))) {`,
    `if ($b.Current.Name -match 'confiance|Trust') { $b.GetCurrentPattern([${A}.InvokePattern]::Pattern).Invoke(); L 'trusted'; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800; break } }`,
    `$e = $w.FindFirst('Descendants', (New-Object ${A}.PropertyCondition($typ, $edit)))`,
    `$t = ''; if ($e) { foreach ($c in $e.FindAll('Descendants', [${A}.Condition]::TrueCondition)) { $t += $c.Current.Name } }`,
    `if ($e -and $t -match '${RESUME_MARK}') { $e.SetFocus(); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300; $s.SendKeys('{ENTER}'); L 'enter'; $done = $true; break } }`,
    "L ('try ' + $i); Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 300 }",
    "L ('end ' + $done); if ($done) { 'sent' }",
  ].join('; ')

import type { RelayRun, RelayStep } from '../types'

export const PANE_WIDTH = 520
const W = PANE_WIDTH
const PAD = 8
const ROW = 64
const PITCH = 74
const TOP = 118
const ACCENT = '#6d5efc'
const GREEN = '#17b26a'
const RED = '#f04438'

const CSS =
  '.card{fill:#f5f6f9;stroke:#e2e5ec}.ink{fill:#14141a}.mute{fill:#6b6f7a}.track{fill:#dcdfe6}' +
  '.ring{fill:none;stroke:#c4c8d2}' +
  '@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){.card{fill:#1e1e23;stroke:#2c2c34}.ink{fill:#f3f3f6}' +
  '.mute{fill:#9a9ca7}.track{fill:#34343d}.ring{stroke:#4b4b56}}' +
  "text{font-family:system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}.mono{font-family:ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace}"

const esc = (t: string) => t.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>')
const cut = (t: string, n: number) => (t.length > n ? `${t.slice(0, n - 1)}…` : t)
const sec = (ms: number) => `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`
const mark = (d: string, extra = '') =>
  `<path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" ${extra}/>`

const icon = (status: RelayStep['status'], cx: number, cy: number): string => {
  const at = `transform="translate(${cx} ${cy})"`
  if (status === 'ok') return `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="14" fill="${GREEN}"/>${mark('M-5 .5l3.5 3.5L6 -4', at)}`
  if (status === 'fail') return `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="14" fill="${RED}"/>${mark('M-4.5 -4.5l9 9M4.5 -4.5l-9 9', at)}`
  if (status === 'wait') return `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="11" class="ring" stroke-width="2"/>`

  return (
    `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="11" class="ring" stroke-width="3"/>` +
    `<circle cx="${cx}" cy="${cy}" r="11" fill="none" stroke="${ACCENT}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="26 44">` +
    `<animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 ${cx} ${cy}" to="360 ${cx} ${cy}" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>`
  )
}

const row = (s: RelayStep, i: number): string => {
  const y = TOP + i * PITCH
  const took = s.startedAt !== undefined && s.endedAt !== undefined ? sec(s.endedAt - s.startedAt) : s.status === 'run' ? '…' : ''
  const edge = s.status === 'run' ? `stroke="${ACCENT}" stroke-width="1.5"` : 'stroke-width="1"'

  return `<g${s.status === 'wait' ? ' opacity=".55"' : ''}>
<rect class="card" x="${PAD}" y="${y}" width="${W - 2 * PAD}" height="${ROW}" rx="14" ${edge}/>${icon(s.status, PAD + 34, y + ROW / 2)}
<text class="ink" x="72" y="${y + 27}" font-size="15" font-weight="600">${esc(s.label)}</text>
<text class="mute" x="72" y="${y + 47}" font-size="12.5">${esc(cut(s.detail ?? '', 64))}</text>
<text class="mute mono" x="${W - PAD - 18}" y="${y + 27}" font-size="12" text-anchor="end">${took}</text></g>`
}

const bar = (steps: RelayStep[]): string => {
  const w = (W - 2 * PAD - 6 * (steps.length - 1)) / steps.length

  return steps
    .map((s, i) => {
      const fill = s.status === 'ok' ? GREEN : s.status === 'fail' ? RED : s.status === 'run' ? ACCENT : ''
      const anim = s.status === 'run' ? '<animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;.35;1" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>' : ''

      return `<rect class="${fill ? '' : 'track'}" ${fill ? `fill="${fill}"` : ''} x="${PAD + i * (w + 6)}" y="88" width="${w}" height="6" rx="3">${anim}</rect>`
    })
    .join('')
}

const header = (run: RelayRun | null): string => {
  const done = run?.endedAt !== undefined
  const tone = !done ? ACCENT : run?.ok ? GREEN : RED
  const label = !done ? 'Working…' : `${run?.ok ? 'Done' : 'Failed'} · ${sec((run?.endedAt ?? 0) - (run?.startedAt ?? 0))}`

  return `<text class="ink" x="${PAD}" y="30" font-size="22" font-weight="700">Handoff</text>
<text class="mute" x="${PAD}" y="52" font-size="12.5">${esc(run?.model ?? '…')} · ${run?.percent ?? '–'}% context</text>
<text class="mute mono" x="${PAD}" y="70" font-size="11.5">${esc(cut(run?.cwd ?? '', 60))}</text>
<rect x="${W - PAD - 124}" y="12" width="124" height="28" rx="14" fill="${tone}" fill-opacity=".15"/>
<text x="${W - PAD - 62}" y="31" font-size="12.5" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" fill="${tone}">${esc(label)}</text>`
}

const footer = (run: RelayRun | null, y: number): string => {
  if (!run?.result) return ''
  const tone = run.ok ? GREEN : RED

  return `<rect x="${PAD}" y="${y}" width="${W - 2 * PAD}" height="62" rx="14" fill="${tone}" fill-opacity=".12" stroke="${tone}" stroke-opacity=".4"/>
<text class="ink" x="${PAD + 18}" y="${y + 26}" font-size="14.5" font-weight="600">${run.ok ? 'New session is running' : 'Handoff stopped'}</text>
<text class="mute" x="${PAD + 18}" y="${y + 46}" font-size="12.5">${esc(cut(run.result, 70))}</text>`
}

/** Height of the drawing, so the surface can be given its size explicitly. */
export const paneHeight = (steps: RelayStep[], run: RelayRun | null): number =>
  TOP + steps.length * PITCH + (run?.result ? 78 : 12)

/** The handoff panel as one vector drawing: header, progress bar, step cards, result. */
export const paneSvg = (steps: RelayStep[], run: RelayRun | null): string => {
  const end = TOP + steps.length * PITCH
  const height = paneHeight(steps, run)

  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${height}" width="${W}" height="${height}"><style>${CSS}</style>${header(run)}${bar(steps)}${steps.map(row).join('')}${footer(run, end + 6)}</svg>`
}
